subject: Post-call recap & proposed rotating windows for technical deep-dive
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@lumenhealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap & proposed rotating windows for technical deep-dive

Hi Sam / Team,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great to hear more about LumenHealth's ingestion patterns and the throughput SLA you're targeting. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can lock the technical deep-dive: 

- Recap: POC scope = real-time inference for triage + batched analytics for overnight scoring; sensitive PHI in transit but not stored long-term. You flagged SOC 2 evidence and a short audit trail requirement.
- Next step: 60-90m technical deep-dive with our infra + SE to demo a small ingest -> model -> observability flow and confirm performance targets.
- Goal: pick a repeating weekly time window that rotates across US / EU / APAC so your global teams can attend without always meeting at night.

Attached: LumenHealth-reqs.pdf (call notes & compliance checklist) and tech-availability-v1.ics (initial proposed times).

Would you prefer we propose a single rotating template (we pick the first 3 weeks and rotate) or build a shared calendar where you select the windows that work best for your squad? Either is fine — here's a quick set of rotating templates we can commit to if helpful:

Template A (compact, single-week rotation) — 60m:
- Week 1: US morning (09:00 PST / 12:00 EST)
- Week 2: EU afternoon (16:00 CET / 15:00 GMT)
- Week 3: APAC evening (20:00 IST / 22:00 SGT)

Template B (longer deep-dive, biweekly, 90m):
- Week 1: US late morning (10:30 PST) + short follow-up notes
- Week 3: EU late afternoon (17:00 CET)

If you can share 2-3 windows that work for the next three weeks I can lock a recurring invite and loop in our SE (Karthik) + procurement (Ben) for contract/PO conversations.

Thanks — available to adapt.

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0119
